title: Knot-Library item envelope
description: Front matter fields shared by every kind of library item. A kind's schema composes this one and may add fields of its own.

id.description: The item's permanent identity: a UUID in canonical lowercase hyphenated form. Never changes once merged, and never reused.

title.description: The item's name as Knot shows it. One line.

description.description: A one-line, plain-text summary Knot shows in lists.

authors.description: Credits: a GitHub handle (@name) or a free-text name each.
